author: Joshua Fluke
description:
CEOs keep posting career advice on LinkedIn that somehow makes them look worse every single time.

One CEO says rejected job applicants should keep talking to the company after being rejected because maybe they can change the hiring manager’s mind.

Another says you won’t build a trillion-dollar company with work-life balance and brags that the office is still busy at 8 p.m. and on weekends.

Another boss says he told a 23-year-old employee to box up his PlayStation at home until he hit his sales numbers — then fired him when he didn’t.

Another founder openly warns candidates that they’ll get messages at 2 a.m. on Tuesdays and 9 p.m. on Saturdays and says employees need to work with the same intensity as the founder.

Then there’s the CEO who says he doesn’t hire people who walk slowly.

And somehow it keeps getting worse.

title: CEOs ARE CRASHING OUT ON LINKEDIN AGAIN
